descriptions.text: 《腎囊醫訣》（Shen nang yi jue）是1874年由寄傲軒印行的中文外科譯著，牛津博德利館目記出版地為[Amoy]。原著者為Thomas Blizard Curling，Patrick Manson譯介並增補解剖及其自身觀察，英文序署Amoy（廈門）。內容涉及外腎、腎囊與腎系諸症、病例、歷史外科技術及圖說，前置文字另有中文序、英文序、總目與中英詞表，可供晚清醫學翻譯、術語及醫學圖像史研究。本版據牛津博德利圖書館Sinica 1845三冊掃描，提供497個原印文字、圖說及圖中文字面的JSON、TXT與TEI，保留裝訂冊原序及印本卷號衝突。本版經AI讀稿比對與原圖覆核，疑讀仍標記，尚未經人類全文校勘；方法與限制見METHODS.md。

Shen nang yi jue (1874), published by Ji ao xuan at [Amoy] according to the Bodleian catalogue, is Patrick Manson’s Chinese translation and adaptation of a work by Thomas Blizard Curling. Its English preface, signed at Amoy, describes additional anatomical material and observations by Manson. The book discusses historical conditions of the testis, scrotum and spermatic cord, case records, surgery and illustrated explanations, with Chinese and English prefaces, a contents list and a bilingual vocabulary. It can support research on late Qing medical translation, terminology and medical illustration. This version provides JSON, TXT and TEI for 497 original printed text, caption and labelled illustration faces from the three bound volumes of Bodleian Sinica 1845, retaining their physical order and conflicting printed volume numbers. This version follows comparison of AI readings and checks against the source images; uncertain readings remain marked, full human collation is pending, and methods and limitations are described in METHODS.md.

methods: All 497 assigned source faces were independently reread by AI and then compared with the fixed initial transcription. Differences, note attachment and source layers were resolved by nonblind return to the original source, retaining localized unresolved readings. The fixed final native manuscripts cover 195, 60, 24, 46, 70 and 102 disjoint faces. This integration copies their chosen text strings, stable identifiers, ordering, note fragments, anchors, source marks and diagram text mechanically; it performs no new image reading, lexical normalization, arithmetic restoration of folios, or modern medical interpretation. Source reading used fixed 1000px previews, full-frame context and selected original-region details; the public source locators retain the original preview coordinate system. Units without reliable calibrated bounds retain null bbox. AI assistance used an OpenAI native subscription service; actual model, effort, tokens and cash are unavailable in the execution evidence and remain null. No human full-text double collation, expert review, peer review, measured CER, Schematron or complete critical apparatus is claimed. The private images, crops, complete event histories, prompts and specialized production programs are not distributed; a complete image-to-text rerun is therefore not supplied. Public JSON, TXT, TEI and companion structures support exact public-data reconstruction. The private base=result legacy-import annotation audit concerns this round of mechanical integration and format preservation only; it is not a new reading, independent collation, or the original v0.1.0-to-v0.2.0 adjudication history. Revision traceability instead rests jointly on the six fixed native adjudication manuscripts and their private decision/seal references, together with the complete public version diff and field-by-field replay.
notes: Source: Bodleian Libraries, University of Oxford, Sinica 1845(1–3),497 original printed text/caption/labelled illustration faces in276 captures. Physical order is I / II+IV / III; the contents/body numbering conflict is preserved. Photographic images and crops are excluded. Historical text is supplied without a new exclusive restriction; CC BY 4.0 applies only to the modern original explanatory documentation. Source photographs retain the Bodleian CC BY-NC 4.0 attribution and terms. The source catalogue records shen nang yi jue; display capitalization only is changed. Its English source-work title is retained as a catalogue reference, not presented as the dataset’s own title. The catalogued publication place [Amoy] keeps its brackets; Aberdeen is the illustration imprint, not the book publication place.
language_basis: Chinese historical text and bilingual vocabulary; English preface and English documentation. Source manifests record Chinese and English.
